mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT contact.*, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id FROM crm_contact contact JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = contact.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = contact.tenant_id WHERE contact.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND contact.deleted = 0 AND customer.deleted = 0 AND contact.status = 'ACTIVE' AND customer.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (contact.contact_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR customer.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ) scoped ORDER BY contact_id DESC

SELECT contact_id, scope_owner_id, scope_dept_id FROM ( SELECT contact.contact_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id FROM crm_contact contact JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = contact.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = contact.tenant_id WHERE contact.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer.deleted = 0 ) scoped ORDER BY contact_id
